paragraphs.text: North Pontotoc’s girls beat Biggersville 54–49 in Ecru on Friday, the Vikings’ third win in four nights. After road victories at Alcorn Central on Tuesday and Water Valley on Thursday, they won their closest game of the three at home to move to 7–2.

The five-point margin was also the narrowest of North Pontotoc’s seven wins on its varsity schedule. The next closest was Tuesday’s 43–35 win at Alcorn Central. At Water Valley, the Vikings won 51–26. Friday was their first home game since a 57–36 victory over Byhalia on Nov. 12.

Biggersville had scored at least 57 points in each of its four previous posted finals. The Lions won all four, including a 64–26 victory over Itawamba Agricultural on Nov. 14. Against North Pontotoc they finished eight points below their previous low.
The next game on North Pontotoc’s posted girls schedule is at Hamilton at 6 p.m. Monday, Nov. 30. The Vikings return to Ecru for a region game with Tishomingo County at 6 p.m. Friday, Dec. 4.
